note: Generated, committed and diff-gated. This construct signs nothing, so there is no keyring: every value is a pure function of the fixtures, which are synthetic by construction (acct-example-N, ledger-example-N, the ISO 4217 testing code XTS, counting-pattern salts). ACCEPT vectors pin paramsHash, canonical and the full display; REJECT vectors pin reasonCode, and TRANSFER_PARSE vectors also pin reasonContains (the reference kernel parser's reason; informative for other implementations). A precedence vector's `beats` names the second rule its input violates, which reasonCode must win over; `equivalentTo` names the accept vector whose binding an alternative spelling must equal. paramsHex carries inputs no text form can (bytes are lowercase hex); every other vector carries paramsText. The pinned hashes are NORMATIVE EXPECTED VALUES, not attestations about any running system (NON-CLAIMS.md §S7). TRANSFER_CANONICAL_REPARSE guards the render node and is unreachable by any input, so no vector carries it.

vectors.name: identity-action-schema
vectors.note: hash = sha256:hex(SHA-256(UTF8(JCS(descriptor)))). `implementation` is SHA-256 of the emitted source text of projectLedgerTransfer, which ships in the published package, so it is recomputable.

vectors.name: identity-display
vectors.note: The same artifact under kind displayProjection. The two identities MUST differ.

vectors.name: accept-base
vectors.note: The conformance tuple. Its paramsHash is the normative base pin; its canonical bytes are the template.

vectors.name: accept-key-order-and-whitespace
vectors.note: Reverse key order plus insignificant whitespace binds the SAME value: JCS sorts keys and the hash covers the re-emitted canonical bytes, never the input bytes.

vectors.name: accept-escaped-spelling
vectors.note: `\u0061` is a JSON escape for `a`; after parsing the value is identical, so the hash is the base hash. A hash over input bytes would differ here.

vectors.name: accept-escaped-key
vectors.note: The KEY spelled `\u0061mount` is the key `amount` after parsing: the closed world and the hash both see the parsed name, so this binds the base value.

vectors.name: accept-drift-amount
vectors.note: One character of the amount (12345 -> 12346) moves the hash.

vectors.name: accept-drift-from
vectors.note: One character of the source account moves the hash.

vectors.name: accept-drift-to
vectors.note: One character of the destination account moves the hash.

vectors.name: accept-drift-ledger
vectors.note: One character of the ledger moves the hash.

vectors.name: accept-drift-salt
vectors.note: One character of the salt moves the hash.

vectors.name: accept-direction-swap
vectors.note: The same two accounts in the opposite direction is a DIFFERENT transfer, with a different hash and display.

vectors.name: accept-amount-min
vectors.note: The smallest amount, 1 whole unit.

vectors.name: accept-amount-max
vectors.note: The largest amount: 15 nines, below 2^53.

vectors.name: accept-from-64
vectors.note: fromAccount: 64 characters is the bound, not 63 (reject-from-65-chars holds the other side).

vectors.name: accept-to-64
vectors.note: toAccount: 64 characters is the bound (reject-to-65-chars holds the other side).

vectors.name: accept-ledger-64
vectors.note: ledger: 64 characters is the bound (reject-ledger-65-chars holds the other side).

vectors.name: accept-from-1-char
vectors.note: fromAccount: one character, first and last at once.

vectors.name: accept-to-1-char
vectors.note: toAccount: one character, first and last at once.

vectors.name: accept-ledger-1-char
vectors.note: ledger: one character, first and last at once.

vectors.name: accept-identifier-inner-hyphens
vectors.note: Hyphens and digits are legal inside an identifier.

vectors.name: accept-salt-all-zero
vectors.note: An all-zero salt is ACCEPTED: a projection cannot test randomness. This pins the non-claim that salt privacy depends on an honest producer (NON-CLAIMS.md §S7).

vectors.name: reject-parse-duplicate-amount
vectors.note: TWO amount members (1, then 100000). Last-wins parsing would bind a value the first reader never saw; the strict parser refuses the document.

vectors.name: reject-parse-proto-key
vectors.note: `__proto__` as an own key is refused at the parse boundary.

vectors.name: reject-parse-constructor-key
vectors.note: `constructor` as an own key is refused at the parse boundary.

vectors.name: reject-parse-truncated
vectors.note: Truncated input.

vectors.name: reject-parse-trailing-bytes
vectors.note: A second value after the document.

vectors.name: reject-parse-float-amount
vectors.note: A JSON float is refused by the parser before any member rule runs.

vectors.name: reject-parse-exponent-amount
vectors.note: A JSON exponent is refused by the parser.

vectors.name: reject-parse-unsafe-integer-amount
vectors.note: 2^53+1 cannot be represented exactly and is refused by the parser.

vectors.name: reject-parse-lone-surrogate-escape
vectors.note: An escaped lone surrogate has no UTF-8 encoding.

vectors.name: reject-parse-raw-control-character
vectors.note: A raw U+0001 inside a string is refused (escaped control characters parse, and are then refused by the member rule).

vectors.name: reject-parse-bom
vectors.note: A UTF-8 byte-order mark is not stripped: it reaches the parser as an unexpected character.

vectors.name: reject-parse-overlong-utf8
vectors.note: 0xC0 0xB1 is an overlong encoding of `1`. Decoding is fatal, never substituted: two byte strings must not decode to one text.

vectors.name: reject-not-object-null
vectors.note: null is not a params object.

vectors.name: reject-not-object-array
vectors.note: An array is not a params object.

vectors.name: reject-not-object-string
vectors.note: A bare string is not a params object.

vectors.name: reject-not-object-number
vectors.note: A bare number is not a params object.

vectors.name: reject-not-object-true
vectors.note: A bare boolean is not a params object.

vectors.name: reject-amount-absent
vectors.note: `amount` missing entirely.

vectors.name: reject-amount-null
vectors.note: `amount`: null is not a value.

vectors.name: reject-amount-empty
vectors.note: `amount`: the empty string is "unspecified" spelled so a presence check cannot see it.

vectors.name: reject-amount-number
vectors.note: A JSON number is not an amount: amounts are strings, so no value passes through binary floating point.

vectors.name: reject-amount-negative-zero
vectors.note: `-0` parses as a number and is refused by the member rule.

vectors.name: reject-amount-array
vectors.note: An array holding the right string is not a string.

vectors.name: reject-amount-boolean
vectors.note: A boolean is not an amount.

vectors.name: reject-amount-zero
vectors.note: Zero is not a transfer.

vectors.name: reject-amount-leading-zero
vectors.note: `012345` would be a second spelling of 12345. One spelling per amount.

vectors.name: reject-amount-plus-sign
vectors.note: No sign.

vectors.name: reject-amount-minus-sign
vectors.note: No sign; a negative transfer is not a transfer.

vectors.name: reject-amount-decimal-point
vectors.note: Scale is 0: whole units only.

vectors.name: reject-amount-exponent
vectors.note: No exponent spelling.

vectors.name: reject-amount-leading-space

vectors.name: reject-amount-trailing-space
vectors.note: No whitespace.

vectors.name: reject-amount-comma-separator
vectors.note: No grouping separator.

vectors.name: reject-amount-underscore-separator
vectors.note: No grouping separator.

vectors.name: reject-amount-16-digits
vectors.note: 16 digits is past the bound (accept-amount-max holds the other side).

vectors.name: reject-amount-fullwidth-digits
vectors.note: U+FF11.. fullwidth digits look like digits and are not ASCII.

vectors.name: reject-amount-arabic-indic-digits
vectors.note: U+0661.. Arabic-Indic digits are digits in another script, not ASCII.

vectors.name: reject-amount-hex

vectors.name: reject-from-null
vectors.note: `fromAccount`: null is not a value.

vectors.name: reject-from-empty
vectors.note: `fromAccount`: the empty string is "unspecified" spelled so a presence check cannot see it.

vectors.name: reject-from-number
vectors.note: A number is not an identifier.

vectors.name: reject-from-object
vectors.note: An object is not an identifier; nothing is coerced to string.

vectors.name: reject-from-uppercase
vectors.note: Case variants are refused, never folded.

vectors.name: reject-from-trailing-space
vectors.note: No whitespace.

vectors.name: reject-from-escaped-newline
vectors.note: An escaped newline passes the parser and is refused here: it could rewrite what the approver reads below it.

vectors.name: reject-from-escaped-nul

vectors.name: reject-from-escaped-ansi

vectors.name: reject-from-zero-width-space

vectors.name: reject-from-cyrillic-homoglyph

vectors.name: reject-from-rtl-override

vectors.name: reject-from-65-chars

vectors.name: reject-from-leading-hyphen

vectors.name: reject-from-leading-digit
vectors.note: The first character must be a letter.

vectors.name: reject-from-trailing-hyphen

vectors.name: reject-from-email

vectors.name: reject-from-dot

vectors.name: reject-from-underscore

vectors.name: reject-from-slash

vectors.name: reject-ledger-null

vectors.name: reject-ledger-empty

vectors.note: Case variants are refused, never folded.

vectors.name: reject-ledger-65-chars
vectors.note: 65 characters is past the bound.

vectors.name: reject-ledger-escaped-ansi

vectors.name: reject-to-null
vectors.note: `toAccount`: null is not a value.

vectors.name: reject-to-empty
vectors.note: `toAccount`: the empty string is "unspecified" spelled so a presence check cannot see it.

vectors.name: reject-to-boolean

vectors.name: reject-to-65-chars

vectors.name: reject-to-escaped-newline
vectors.note: An escaped newline.

vectors.name: reject-unit-lowercase
vectors.note: The enum is exact; case variants are refused.

vectors.name: reject-unit-trailing-space

vectors.name: reject-unit-cyrillic-homoglyph

vectors.note: Free text the approver would not see. An unrecognized own member is refused.

vectors.name: reject-extra-fee
vectors.note: A fee is policy, not a bound member. An unrecognized own member is refused.

vectors.name: reject-extra-reference
vectors.note: Another display surface with confusable characters; not bound. An unrecognized own member is refused.

vectors.name: reject-extra-reversible
vectors.note: Reversibility is not a caller-supplied member. An unrecognized own member is refused.

vectors.name: reject-extra-risk-class
vectors.note: Risk is derived by the enforcing gate, never supplied. An unrecognized own member is refused.

vectors.name: reject-extra-idempotency-key
vectors.note: Idempotency belongs to the request, not to the bound transfer. An unrecognized own member is refused.

vectors.name: reject-extra-expires-at
vectors.note: Time windows belong to the authorization, not to the transfer. An unrecognized own member is refused.

vectors.name: reject-extra-approver
vectors.note: Approvers belong to the authorization. An unrecognized own member is refused.

vectors.name: reject-extra-case-variant-amount
vectors.note: `Amount` differs from `amount` only in case — still unrecognized. An unrecognized own member is refused.

vectors.name: reject-extra-leading-space-amount
vectors.note: ` amount` is a different key. An unrecognized own member is refused.

vectors.name: reject-extra-short-from
vectors.note: `from` is not `fromAccount`. An unrecognized own member is refused.

vectors.name: reject-extra-case-variant-to
vectors.note: `To` is not `toAccount`. An unrecognized own member is refused.

vectors.name: reject-extra-nested-meta
vectors.note: A nested object. An unrecognized own member is refused.

vectors.name: reject-extra-amount-minor
vectors.note: A second amount beside `amount`: a scaled spelling must not ride along. An unrecognized own member is refused.

vectors.name: reject-same-account
vectors.note: A transfer from an account to itself is refused.

vectors.name: reject-same-account-escaped-spelling
vectors.note: The escaped spelling `\u0061cct-example-1` is the same account after parsing; the comparison runs on parsed values.

vectors.name: reject-precedence-parse-first
vectors.note: A duplicate key, a bad amount and an extra member at once: the parse layer answers first.

vectors.name: reject-precedence-amount-before-from
vectors.note: Bad amount and bad fromAccount: amount is checked first.

vectors.name: reject-precedence-from-before-ledger
vectors.note: Bad fromAccount and empty ledger: fromAccount is checked before ledger.

vectors.name: reject-precedence-ledger-before-salt
vectors.note: Empty ledger and empty salt: ledger is checked before salt.

vectors.name: reject-precedence-salt-before-to
vectors.note: Uppercase salt and empty toAccount: salt is checked before toAccount.

vectors.name: reject-precedence-to-before-unit
vectors.note: Empty toAccount and a foreign unit: toAccount is checked before unit.

vectors.name: reject-precedence-unit-before-closed-world
vectors.note: Bad unit and an extra member: member rules run before the closed world.

vectors.name: reject-precedence-closed-world-before-same-account
vectors.note: An extra member and a self-transfer: the closed world runs before the two-member rule.

vectors.name: reject-precedence-salt-before-same-account
vectors.note: Bad salt and a self-transfer: member rules run before the two-member rule (a non-adjacent pair).
